items.reason: Red Leader's cost reduction counts only "friendly Pilot unit and upgrade" and its trigger needs "a Pilot upgrade attaches"; X-Wing tokens are not Pilots and it has no sac, count or enter-play payoff. Agrees with haiku.
Han Solo's "When played as an upgrade: You may attack with attached unit" attacks with Trask Walker (a Vehicle), firing "When Played/On Attack". Agrees with haiku.

Milodon Rider's "return another friendly non-leader unit to its owner's hand" can bounce Grand Army Marine, whose "When Played: Give a Shield token to a friendly Gungan unit" replays. Agrees with haiku.

Evil is Everywhere says "Defeat a unit with cost equal to or less than the number of Villainy aspect icons among friendly units"; the target is any unit, so it does not want your own Spy tokens as fodder. Agrees with haiku.
Secretive Sage is a Force unit and The Burden of Masters references the Force trait: "Put a Force unit from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck." Agrees with haiku.
Let's Call It War: "Deal 3 damage to a unit" can hit friendly Lando Calrissian (8 HP), who has Grit. Agrees with haiku.

The Burden of Masters: "play a unit from your hand and give 2 Experience tokens to it" (Experience counts as an upgrade) turns on Peppi Bow's "While this unit is upgraded, she gets +1/+1". Agrees with haiku.
Darth Sidious: "defeat each non-Sith unit with 3 or less remaining HP" defeats Jedi In Hiding (Force/Jedi, 3 HP), firing "When Defeated". Agrees with haiku.
Chewbacca: "Attack with a unit, even if it's exhausted" attacks with deployed Darth Vader, firing his "On Attack". Agrees with haiku.
Sweep the Area returns units "with a combined cost 3 or less"; Syndicate Spice Runner (cost 2) can be bounced and replayed for "When Played: Search the top 3 cards". Agrees with haiku.
Stronger Together: "Create 2 Mandalorian tokens" adds units toward Obi-Wan's "While you control 7 or more units". Agrees with haiku.
Emissary's Sheathipede is Separatist/Vehicle/Transport and Captain Tarkin says "Each friendly Vehicle unit gets +1/+0 and gains Overwhelm." Agrees with haiku.

Tempest Assault only deals "2 damage to each enemy space unit" and only if you damaged an enemy base this phase; it does not defeat anything unless the unit has 2 or less HP, so it is not reliable removal for Bo-Katan's defeat trigger. Agrees with haiku.
Industrious Team: "defeat a non-leader unit with 4 or less remaining HP" can defeat your 2/2 Reanimated Night Trooper, firing its "When Defeated". Agrees with haiku.
Baylan Skoll returns "a non-leader unit that costs 4 or less" and its owner "may play it for free"; Profiteering Hunter (cost 1) replays its "When Played". Agrees with haiku.
Mystic Monastery: "The Force is with you (create your Force token)" fuels Eighth Brother's "You may use the Force (lose your Force token)". Agrees with haiku.
Krrsantan's "Return this unit to your hand" returns only itself, never War Juggernaut, and Krrsantan has no When Played. Agrees with haiku.
Pounce: "Attack with a Creature unit. It gets +4/+0"; Drengir Spawn is a Creature and its "When this unit attacks and defeats a unit" trigger is boosted by the +4. Agrees with haiku.

Arihnda Pryce's "defeat another friendly unit" is a defeat outlet (and only when she is defeated); Blade of Talzin's "return this upgrade from your discard pile" concerns only itself and does not use other discarded cards. Overrides haiku (correct to wrong).
Catch the Scent: "ready 1 of them" readies only a new Beast token, not 0-0-0. Agrees with haiku.
Governor's Shuttle: "Each player chooses a unit they control. Defeat those units" lets you choose Skyway Cloud Car, firing its "When Defeated". Agrees with haiku.
Darth Vader's Piloting upgrade can attach only to a Vehicle unit, and Arena Nexu is a Creature, so he cannot give it "On Attack: You may deal 1 damage to a unit". Overrides haiku (unsure to wrong).

Focus Fire: "Choose a unit. Each friendly Vehicle unit in the same arena deals damage equal to its power to that unit" leaves a damaged unit for Red Five's "On Attack: You may deal 2 damage to a damaged unit". Agrees with haiku.
Supporting Eta-2 is Republic/Vehicle/Fighter and Echo Base Engineer says "give a Shield token to a damaged Vehicle unit." Agrees with haiku.
Iden Versio's "When this upgrade attaches to a unit: Give a Shield token" does not depend on other upgrades, so a Shield from Covering the Wing gives her no benefit. Agrees with haiku.
